title: Riot Squad BLCK EDTN Sour Apple & Cherry 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid 2 Pack
description: This Pack Contains x2 50ml Shortfills Sour Cherry & Apple from Riot Squad’s premium Black Edition shortfill range is a giddy candy blend with the authentic taste of delicious fruits. Rich, tangy and deliciously sour cherry notes collide with fresher, sweeter apple flavour for a mouth-watering vape experience. This pack contains two 50ml nicotine-free shortfill bottles and both bottles come with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your exact liking. Their 70VG/30PG ratio makes them ideal for high-powered sub-ohm tanks and mods.
